 Galveston County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0024
 Richard Smith, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
12-5-24
Counsel for defendant:
Richard Marshall, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant, through its undersigned counsel, files this Original Answer to Plaintiff's Original Pettiion and respectfully
shows the Court as follows.
Defendant generally denies each and every allegation contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition and demands strict
proof thereof by a preponderance of the evidence, as permitted by Rule 92 of the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure.
For its affirmative defenses, Defendant asserts first that Plaintiff's own negligence proportionately caused the
collision, in that Plaintiff failed to keep a proper lookout and failed to confirm that the adjacent lane was clear before
moving into it. Under Chapter 33 of the Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code, any recovery must be reduced by
Plaintiff's percentage of responsibility.
Defendant asserts second that the collision and the injuries claimed were caused in whole or in part by the acts or
omissions of a third party, and Defendant requests that the responsibility of such persons be submitted to the jury.
Defendant asserts third that Plaintiff failed to mitigate damages by not following reasonable medical advice and by
incurring treatment that was not reasonably necessary for the injuries arising from the collision.
Defendant reserves the right to amend this Answer as discovery proceeds.
</page>

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
